quests.title: Start with a Simple Ingredient
quests.action: Choose 1 simple ingredient you have on hand, such as flour, sugar, or an essential spice.
quests.completion_criteria: You have selected an ingredient and it is ready for use in your dish.
quests.hint: Focus on a single component to build your foundation.

quests.title: Prepare a Basic Base
quests.action: Mix the selected ingredient with a small amount of water or liquid to create a base.
quests.completion_criteria: You have created a basic base using the selected ingredient and it is ready for further steps.
quests.hint: Start with a small quantity to avoid overloading your workspace.

quests.title: Create a Simple Taste Test
quests.action: Taste the base to observe its flavor and texture.
quests.completion_criteria: You have tasted the base and observed its flavor and texture, confirming it is ready for further development.
quests.hint: Focus on a single taste to identify any adjustments needed.
